title: ITSE-1311 Images, Compression, Favicons, and Tables Quiz

questions.question: What are the ways listed in the text to make our pages use less bandwidth? Select all that apply. Choices: By using a combination of image types; Upgrading the router; By using canvas; By reproducing images using CSS.
Which recreates an image by recording the color value of pixels, which represent the smallest single point on a screen that can be assigned a color by the display? Choices: Raster; Vector.
Which stores information about colors and locations as definitions of angles, lines, and curves in mathematical format? Choices: Vector; Raster.
Which can result in greater compression, but achieves the extra advantage by removing information from the file? Choices: lossless; lossy.
Which does not remove data from the original copy, so we can restore the image to its exact original size and appearance? Choices: lossy; lossless.
Which achieves the extra advantage by removing information from the file? Choices: PNG; TIFF; GIF; BMP; JPEG.
When should we use gifs according to the text? Choices: for smaller icons and indicators; for our larger images or photos,.
When should we use jpgs according to the text? Choices: for our larger images or photos; for smaller icons and indicators.
How does the text explain which compression is better? Choices: lossless; it depends; lossy.
Which are the techniques explained in the text to reduce image weight on a site? Select all that apply. Choices: sprites; slicing; caching; right-sizing images.

Which are true concerning favicon? Select all that apply. Choices: are usually 32 by 32 pixel images; accompanies the page title in the browser's tab; automatically used on each page found in the folder the favicon is stored in; represents the site or site's parent company.
What do the "tr" tags represent? Choices: columns; rows; headers.
What do the "td" tags represent? Choices: headers; rows; columns.
What do the "th" tags represent? Choices: rows; headers; columns.

Which code represents the two merged cells below? The table has a top cell labeled Merged spanning two columns, with rows 1/a and 2/b below. Choices: td rowspan = "2"; td rowspan = "3"; td colspan = "2"; td colspan = "3".

Which code represents the three merged cells below? The table has a right-side cell labeled Merged spanning three rows, with rows 1/a, 2/b, and 3/c to its left. Choices: td colspan = "3"; td rowspan = "2"; td rowspan = "3"; td colspan = "2".
